hook: FMG interns get *Rs 5,000*; local MBBS interns *Rs 29,792*
hook_b: FMG interns get *Rs 5,000*; local MBBS interns *Rs 29,792*
tldr: Foreign Medical Graduate interns' statewide protest hit day 34, with police detaining protesters near the Telangana Medical Council office in Koti.

beats.what: Tuesday was the sixth day of a relay hunger strike; interns work in government teaching hospitals.
beats.why: They demand stipend parity, clearance of arrears and protection from disciplinary action.
beats.care: These interns staff government teaching hospitals across Telangana.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Day 34 of protests, day 6 of relay hunger strike; police detained protesters near TSMC office, Koti. TJUDA and medical bodies urged Health Minister Damodar Raja Narasimha to intervene.

cards.q: Should interns with the same workload get the same stipend?

qs: What does the health department say about the stipend gap?
How many FMG interns are posted in Telangana hospitals?

facts.t: Tuesday was the *sixth day* of the relay hunger strike and the 34th day of protests.

viz.verdict: FMG interns get about one-sixth for the same clinical work, they say

steps.e: 6th day of relay hunger strike; police detain protesters at Koti

learn.t: FMG = Foreign Medical Graduate, an Indian who studied medicine abroad.

watch: Whether the health department meets the interns; no talks announced in the report.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: FMG interns face police action near TSMC office as hunger strike enters critical phase

fact: FMG interns earn *Rs 5,000* a month; local MBBS interns get *Rs 29,792*.
twist: Their stipend arrears have been pending since January 2026, per the protesters.
